rule: Do not pool these metrics: they have different targets and evidence.

expert_pdf_agreement.target: frozen expert PDF label; agreement/reproduction only

historical_engine_holdout.target: expert/PDF labels on chronological holdout; not real-world outcome

real_world_outcomes.target: independent Chrono/Telegram result paired with a frozen prior prediction

next_action: Freeze a daily snapshot before the day starts and pair it with one independently defined outcome; do not change weights before the pre-registered gate passes.
